<?php
class Base185Frame { public const VALUE = 1; }
class Owner185Frame extends Base185Frame { public const VALUE = 2; public function make() { yield 'PAUSE'; yield new class(parent::VALUE, self::VALUE, static::VALUE, __CLASS__, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public int $parent, public int $self, public int $called, public string $owner, public string $method) {} }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'DROP;'; } }
class Child185Frame extends Owner185Frame { public const VALUE = 3; }
$owner = new Child185Frame; $g = $owner->make(); unset($owner); echo 'CREATED;', $g->current(), ';'; $g->next(); $child = $g->current(); echo $child->parent, ';', $child->self, ';', $child->called, ';', $child->owner, ';', $child->method, ';', $child::class, ';'; $g->next(); echo 'CLOSED;'; unset($g); echo 'AFTER;';

<?php
trait T185Static { public static function make() { try { yield 'PAUSE'; } catch (Exception $e) { yield new class(self::VALUE, static::VALUE, __CLASS__, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public int $self, public int $called, public string $owner, public string $method) {} }; } } }
class Owner185Static { use T185Static; public const VALUE = 4; }
class Child185Static extends Owner185Static { public const VALUE = 5; }
$g = Child185Static::make(); echo $g->current(), ';'; $child = $g->throw(new Exception('resume')); echo $child->self, ';', $child->called, ';', $child->owner, ';', $child->method, ';', $child::class, ';'; $g->next(); echo 'DONE;';

<?php
$owner = new class { public function make() { yield 7; return new class {}; } };
$g = $owner->make(); $g->next(); $child = $g->getReturn(); $after = new class {}; echo $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', $after::class, ';', ($owner !== $child), ';';

<?php
class Owner185Arrow { public const VALUE = 9; public function make() { yield fn() => new class(self::VALUE, __CLASS__, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public int $value, public string $owner, public string $method) {} }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'DROP;'; } }
$owner = new Owner185Arrow; $g = $owner->make(); unset($owner); $factory = $g->current(); unset($g); echo 'HELD;'; $child = $factory(); echo $child->value, ';', $child->owner, ';', $child->method, ';', $child::class, ';'; unset($factory); echo 'AFTER;';

<?php
class Owner185Return { public function make(): int { yield new class { final private function hidden() {} }; } }
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
trait T185Default { public function make() { yield 1; return new class { public function bad(int $value = 'wrong') {} }; } }
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
$owner = new class { public static function make() { yield 8; return new class {}; } };
$g = $owner::make(); $g->next(); $child = $g->getReturn(); $after = new class {}; echo $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', $after::class, ';', ($owner !== $child), ';';
